# The key drag of the timeline in model mode (HandleMouseMove, RemapList):
# the marked bone keys dragged back past the head key, which holds them, then
# the marked bone and display keys dragged forward. The bones of chain8 are
# in folded display groups, so the press lands on the group row.
load model chain8.pmx
frame 15
register display
select bone センター
frame 10
bone position 1 0 0
register bone
frame 20
bone position 2 0 0
register bone
frame 30
bone position 3 0 0
register bone
save pmm registered.pmm

select all bone
frame 20
drag 20 -15
save pmm back.pmm

select all bone
select all display
frame 15
drag 15 40
save pmm forward.pmm
save vmd forward.vmd
